description: Routing contract for the four domain skills. These cases are deterministic trigger fixtures; they do not claim model-quality or runtime activation without an OMP model run.

cases.prompt: Use $accessibility-audit to audit the checkout dialog's keyboard order, focus return, labels, contrast, and error state at mobile width.
acceptance: explicit skill invocation is honored
report includes direct keyboard and DOM evidence
visual claims are not inferred from source

cases.prompt: The new account form works with a mouse but focus disappears after the validation error. Check the user-visible accessibility regression.
acceptance: focus/error journey is scoped
negative state is exercised
result uses PASS/FAIL/UNPROVEN/BLOCKED

cases.prompt: Before shipping this modal redesign, verify semantic names, keyboard dismissal, reduced motion, target sizes, and 200% zoom against the accepted contract.
acceptance: contract is read before the audit
modal and zoom checks are present
no second accessibility framework is installed

cases.prompt: Fix the database index for the invoice query and add a unit test for the query planner; no user-facing route changes are involved.
acceptance: skill is not routed to a backend-only change
native implementation/testing flow remains available

cases.prompt: Explain how OMP's native browser ARIA snapshot command works; do not audit an application route or change a project.
acceptance: skill does not replace native tool documentation
no product evidence is fabricated

cases.prompt: Use $web-performance to measure the dashboard before and after the hero-image change, including LCP, INP, CLS, and the mobile slow-network profile.
acceptance: same route/profile is compared
lab and field evidence are separated
before-and-after measurements are recorded

cases.prompt: The landing page now ships three font families and a larger bundle. Find the measurable loading and interaction regression without adding speculative tooling.
acceptance: baseline is captured or limitation is stated
font/JavaScript work is measured
no fixed sleeps or network-idle gate is used

cases.prompt: Our release criterion is p75 Core Web Vitals for the product route. Check the largest content state on desktop and mobile and propose one evidence-backed fix.
acceptance: accepted budget is preferred
demanding state is exercised
one fix is re-measured on the same profile

cases.prompt: Rewrite the empty-state copy for clarity. The markup, assets, requests, and interaction behavior are unchanged.
acceptance: skill is not routed to behavior-neutral copy editing
native writing/editing flow remains available

cases.prompt: Tell me which OMP model role is fastest for a tiny local refactor; no route, asset, or runtime measurement is requested.
acceptance: skill does not replace native model routing
no unmeasured speed claim is made

cases.prompt: Use $technical-seo to verify the public article's canonical URL, robots, sitemap entry, rendered title, JSON-LD, and redirect behavior.
acceptance: public route is classified before crawling
delivered HTML and response are checked
structured data is not treated as a rich-result guarantee

cases.prompt: We changed locale URLs and metadata for an indexable marketing page. Check hreflang, canonical consistency, status codes, and the sitemap.
acceptance: locale variants are included
canonical and sitemap are checked together
missing production evidence is labeled

cases.prompt: Audit the built output for a new public product page; make sure search crawlers receive meaningful HTML rather than only a client-hydrated shell.
acceptance: source HTML is distinguished from hydrated DOM
visible content and metadata are checked
no invented product/schema facts

cases.prompt: Add server-side authorization to the private billing console and test that unauthenticated users receive 403; the route must remain non-indexable.
acceptance: skill is not routed to an authorization-only change
private route is not made indexable
security review remains native

cases.prompt: Translate five internal support messages. They are not public pages and no URLs, metadata, or crawl behavior changes.
acceptance: skill is not routed to translation-only work
no search-discoverability claim is made

cases.prompt: Use $rtl-i18n to audit the Persian checkout at narrow width, including direction switching, logical spacing, mixed URLs, currency formatting, and validation errors.
acceptance: RTL and locale are exercised directly
mixed-direction content is isolated
long/error states are checked

cases.prompt: Arabic navigation is visually mirrored, but the back icon and keyboard order feel wrong. Diagnose the direction and interaction behavior.
acceptance: intentional versus blind mirroring is considered
keyboard and visual direction are both checked
the scope stays on the localized UI

cases.prompt: Before release, test Hebrew long strings, dates, numbers, phone numbers, code snippets, and a runtime LTR/RTL switch at 320 CSS pixels.
acceptance: long content and narrow reflow are tested
LTR islands remain readable
locale-sensitive formatting is observed

cases.prompt: Add a retry with exponential backoff to an English-only server API. There is no UI, locale, or translated content in this change.
acceptance: skill is not routed to an API-only change
native reliability/testing flow remains available

cases.prompt: Translate a standalone paragraph from English to Persian; no layout, direction, formatting, or application behavior is involved.
acceptance: skill is not routed to translation-only work
no layout evidence is invented
